title: Protection status is hard to read against the navy background
reproduction: Compare active and stopped protection labels against the actual Home background
expected: At least 4.5 to 1 contrast for both states
observed: Old inactive and active labels had contrast 1.71 and 2.30 to 1
fix: Use separate accessible protection text colors without changing badge or switch colors
test_evidence: HomeProtectionStatusRegressionInstrumentedTest asserts actual color and background contrast; five Home cases passed on non-root API34; fixed ratios 8.57 and 10.13 to 1

title: Large text lets the status run into the counter badges
reproduction: Open Home at Android font scale 1.6
expected: Reserve sufficient vertical space for wrapped status and counter badges
observed: The counters were anchored to the logo without respecting the status bottom
fix: Use a bottom barrier and separate space for the raised counter badges
test_evidence: API34 matrix verifies status and counter bounds at all five variants including mirrored Hebrew; inspected rendered screenshots under deep-visual-populated

title: An RTL-labelled run could silently capture an English left-to-right app
reproduction: Run the old RTL variants then inspect the real app configuration and bottom navigation
expected: Each snapshot must have the requested language and direction
observed: RTL-labelled screenshots showed English with Home on the left
fix: Pass explicit locale and scale to instrumentation and verify the activity locale and root view layout direction on every captured screen
test_evidence: API34 matrix rendered 8 screens at each of 5 variants; Home moved to the right in he-IL and the guard verified the direction

title: Discovery and Sources screenshots can be taken before rows are displayed
reproduction: Run a visual matrix with no directory fetched yet
expected: Exercise visible catalog and source rows rather than an unpopulated screen
observed: Original suite accepted screenshots before a row was drawn
fix: Install a deterministic test-only directory and require a displayed list child before capture
test_evidence: Five populated API34 variants passed; DiscoverFilterListsFiltersInstrumentedTest separately confirmed the shared fixture works; live network behavior is a different check

title: Protection and navigation fall back to English in a Hebrew app
reproduction: Open Home in he-IL and inspect navigation and the protection switch and status
expected: Use local labels for these key controls
observed: English status and navigation appeared next to translated labels
fix: Translate the scoped missing labels and source count plurals
test_evidence: Visually checked genuine he-IL at 1.3 and 1.6; this is not a whole-app translation sign-off
